V2.28.b-i3 parity cert for the first non-hybrid MoE model shipped on flambeau (qwen3moe arch — plain full-attn, routed MoE, no shared expert, no GDN).

Seed token 9419 = ' species' (space-prefixed BPE id) in the Qwen3-Coder tokenizer.

Reference oracle: llama.cpp b7975-4bf202d4a (libllama 0.0.8704) on ROCm 6.4 + 2×MI50, split-mode layer. POST /completion {prompt:[9419], n_predict:8, temperature:0, cache_prompt:false, return_tokens:true}. Decoded content: ': " + species + " and "'. Tokens: [25, 330, 488, 9419, 488, 330, 323, 330].

Flambeau: forward_smoke_qwen3_coder at Mesh<4> 100 W/GPU (forward_prefill_pp with single seed token 9419 → seeded argmax 25; followed by forward_one_token_pp × 7 greedy steps from seed). Matches **8/8 bit-exact**.

Context:
  - V2.28.b-i0 (load smoke) green on Mesh<4> (16.45 GiB total / 4.11 GiB per rank).
  - V2.28.b-i1 (dense attention forward) — plain Q projection, no post-attn sigmoid.
  - V2.28.b-i2 (1-token + short-L smoke) — prior result 4/4 bit-exact.
  - V2.31.a (indexed_moe_mmq_q5_k_down_tile8 MoE prefill kernel) landed in between; parity preserved at decode (decode doesn't exercise tile8 path since n_tokens=1 < 32).
  - V2.31.g (batched dense_gemv_f32_f16 router prefill) landed in between; decode uses forward_router_decode (unchanged single-token path) so no impact on this cert.

Environment notes for regeneration:
  llama.cpp_mi50 build against ROCm 6.4 is the combo that initializes devices + succeeds on kernel launch. /artefact/llama.cpp/build-mi50 (ROCm 7.1.1 targeted) fails with 'device kernel image is invalid' on this rig — likely ABI skew between its compiled .hsaco blobs and the installed libamdhip64. For future Coder parity work, stick to:
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/artefact/llama.cpp_mi50/build/bin:/opt/rocm-6.4.0/lib \
      /artefact/llama.cpp_mi50/build/bin/llama-server \
        -m /artefact/models/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf \
        -ngl 99 --device ROCm0,ROCm1 --split-mode layer \
        --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --no-webui

  curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/completion -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"prompt":[9419],"n_predict":8,"temperature":0,"cache_prompt":false,"return_tokens":true}'

Flambeau regeneration:
  cargo test --release -p flambeau-qwen3-moe --features hip --test forward_smoke_qwen3_coder -- --nocapture

Regenerate this cert by updating expected_token_ids with fresh llama.cpp output if the reference quantisation or tokenizer changes.
